compute_dataset_size_response: compute the dataset size response for a HuggingFace dataset including config and split sizes
run_dataset_size_job: run the DatasetSizeJobRunner to compute and return size metrics for a HuggingFace dataset
aggregate_config_sizes: aggregate config size data across all configs to compute total dataset bytes and row counts
handle_pending_failed_jobs: handle pending and failed config-size jobs when computing dataset size for incomplete pipelines
get_dataset_size_job_type: get the job type string 'dataset-size' from the DatasetSizeJobRunner static method
